objective: Verify that source, key, compare, and data type semantics match the preset schema and user-facing controls.
preconditions: A fixture listing exists with text, numeric, date, taxonomy, and meta values.
The resolver can be exercised through REST or a controlled PHP harness.
Preset schema exposes source, compare, data_type, and key values.
steps: Test contains, equals, in, between, gte, lte, and exists where supported.
Test numeric and date coercion with invalid values.
expected_result: Resolver behavior matches the preset schema instead of ignoring advanced source fields.
pass_criteria: meta filters do not rely only on visible text fallback.
numeric range handles numeric values, zero, and invalid values deterministically.
date range handles valid and invalid dates deterministically.
substring false positives are documented or fixed by exact-token semantics.
